title: China’s Spies Set Sights on A.I. Chips Years Before Nvidia Scandal
summary_full: China’s espionage agency has been running a secret campaign to help the country’s companies acquire advanced A.I. chips and to gather intelligence on the sector, officials say.
summary_public: China’s espionage agency has been running a secret campaign to help the country’s companies acquire advanced A.I. chips and to gather intelligence on the sector, officials say.
